phases.instructions: Review the actual original v10 save actor/name/title, displayed saved date and initial native Rite/Faith identity. Use typed native queries/actions first; retain any real capability/legality RED before official UI fallback. Show the ordinary doctrine candidates (blank-picker regression), COMMIT one legal ordinary doctrine replacement and verify exactly one current choice in that group, then COMMIT a core tenet replacement and verify the old core item is absent and the new item occurs once. Observe religion-change notifications until they finish and record the actual observation duration. If the saved actor lacks a legal creation/edit path, preserve RED; do not change the player, government, tested doctrines/tenets, or resource state through fixtures/console. Return legacy_readback with loaded_identity {save pin, player_id, date_raw, rite_id, faith_id, body_date}, ordinary_doctrine {group, old, new, committed:true, current:[new]}, core_tenets {old, new, committed:true, current:[actual current core keys]}, and notifications {observed_seconds, recurring:false, remaining_religion_change_notifications:0}. Pin real before/after native/UI and timed notification evidence. Draft selection, ACKs or pre-existing saved values do not prove a replacement. This is a historical-save regression, not strict cold-origin acceptance. Leave 900 seconds for the shared actual normal Quit.

ownership: Product-specific v10 save regression and evidence belong to MTS. Profile preparation, native runtime/MCP, Steam/screen/process custody and normal exit remain shared framework capabilities.

required_inputs.saved_campaign: Explicit exact save/bytes/sha256/player_id/date_raw; actual save player is read independently. Text save dates do not supply a native raw-date decoder.
